title: Merchandise Purchases Returns & Exchanges Terms — Schedule of Return Windows by Merchandise Class
content:
The return terms of **Merchandise Purchases** are counted from the unit's completed date: the delivery date for a shipped unit, the date of collection for a store pickup, the completed delivery date for home delivery, and the purchase date for a carry-out purchase. Every period below that is stated in days is counted in calendar days after that completed date.

## 1. Ordinary return window and even exchanges

| Merchandise class | Return window (calendar days after the completed date) | Even exchange window (calendar days after the completed date) |
|---|---|---|
| Apparel, Shoes & Accessories | 90 | 90 |
| Beauty & Fragrance | 60 | 60 |
| Home & Kitchen | 90 | 90 |
| Electronics & Small Appliances | 30 | 30 |
| Fine Jewelry & Watches | 30 | 30 |
| Designer Handbags & Luxury | 30 | 30 |
| Furniture & Mattresses | 30 | 30 |

The return window of every class starts at the completed date.

## 2. Holiday purchases

| Merchandise class | Holiday return deadline offered |
|---|---|
| Apparel, Shoes & Accessories | Yes |
| Beauty & Fragrance | Yes |
| Home & Kitchen | Yes |
| Electronics & Small Appliances | Yes |
| Fine Jewelry & Watches | No |
| Designer Handbags & Luxury | No |
| Furniture & Mattresses | No |

For every class the holiday purchase window runs from 1 November through 24 December, and the holiday return deadline is 31 January of the following year. Where a class offers it, a purchase made in that window has the holiday deadline when that deadline is later than the ordinary one.

## 3. Defects, transit damage and warranty referral

| Merchandise class | Defective item still returnable until (calendar days after the completed date) | Transit damage must be reported within (calendar days after the completed date) | Defect reported after the defective window referred to the manufacturer warranty |
|---|---|---|---|
| Apparel, Shoes & Accessories | 180 | 30 | No |
| Beauty & Fragrance | 90 | 30 | No |
| Home & Kitchen | 180 | 30 | Yes |
| Electronics & Small Appliances | 90 | 15 | Yes |
| Fine Jewelry & Watches | 365 | 2 | Yes |
| Designer Handbags & Luxury | 180 | 2 | No |
| Furniture & Mattresses | 365 | 3 | Yes |

### Hypothetical illustrations (figures chosen for the example only)

- A Beauty & Fragrance unit and a Home & Kitchen unit both completed on the same day: the Beauty & Fragrance unit's ordinary window is 60 days, the Home & Kitchen unit's is 90 days.
- A Fine Jewelry & Watches unit bought on 3 December: its class offers no holiday deadline, so only its 30-day window counts. An Apparel, Shoes & Accessories unit bought the same day may also look to 31 January of the following year.
- A Furniture & Mattresses unit damaged in transit must be reported within 3 days of delivery; an Apparel, Shoes & Accessories unit within 30.
